item.title: Zimmer Biomet Receives U.S. FDA Clearance for Enhanced Version of ROSA® Knee Robotic Technology
item.description: Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc., a global medical technology leader, announced Friday, Nov. 14, U.S. Food and Drug Administration 510(k) clearance of ROSA® Knee with OptimiZe™, an enhanced version of its ROSA® Knee System that offers a more customized experience for surgeons to help deliver accurate and reproducible outcomes in robotic-assisted total knee replacement surgery.

item.title: Bob Ross Paintings Fetch Over $600K For Public TV Stations
item.description: Three paintings by beloved public television artist Bob Ross sold for a combined $661,900 at auction Tuesday, Nov. 11, with proceeds benefiting PBS stations affected by federal funding cuts.
